From Cream Starter · Price: the spray can heal or harm, but your healing spray uses your own flesh (you lose HP to heal others).

Theme Matter and Life

  • 1: 1 action: spray flesh to close an ally's wound: lose up to @Damage[(1+floor((@actor.level - 1)/4))d6[force]] HP, and the ally heals twice that much. 1 action: spray a creature's mouth or eyes shut (@Check[reflex|against:stand]{Reflex} negates): @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{blinded} or can't speak for 1 round. 1 action: spray flesh onto a creature within 30 ft of your stand and tear it away with a strip of its own: @Damage[(1+floor((@actor.level - 1)/4))d6[slashing]] damage (@Check[fortitude|against:stand|basic]{basic Fortitude}).
  • 5: A creature that critically fails against your spray stays sealed for 1 minute. You can spray two creatures' mouths or eyes shut with one action. Surge, 1 action: heal an ally @Damage[(2+floor((@actor.level - 1)/2))d8+@actor.system.abilities.cha.mod[healing]]{2d8 + your Charisma modifier, +1d8 at every odd level}, without losing HP.
  • 9: You can split your surge heal between two allies within 30 ft (roll once, divide as you like).
  • 13: Disguise a creature's face with flesh, as Disguise. A creature that fails against your tearing spray is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{blinded} for 1 round.
  • 17: Seal a creature's breathing: suffocating for 1 round (@Check[fortitude|against:stand]{Fortitude} negates).

Defaults: Stand, Occult and Concentrate traits; a surge costs 1 Stand Point and 2 actions unless listed; ranges are measured from your stand; untyped damage is force; saves use your stand DC. A minion an ability makes, unless it says otherwise, is a creature of your level – 2 built with GM Core's Low numbers (Building Creatures), with the minion trait.
